title: Straylight Control Plane event record (v1)
description: One append-oriented lane event, embedded in a GitHub comment after the marker `<!-- straylight:event:v1 -->`. Protocol convention: events are appended, not edited or deleted; corrections are new events. GitHub comments are technically editable/deletable, so reconstruction routes any comment whose updated_at is after created_at to operator-required (a documented v1 shadow-mode limitation, not a cryptographic guarantee). Executable validator: .straylight/lib/validate.mjs#validateEvent.

sequence.description: Must equal the lane's event_sequence + 1 or the reducer refuses it (stale-sequence).

actor_role.description: CLAIMED role. Not a cryptographic identity — the reducer cross-checks the authenticated GitHub commenter against the per-role allowlist in automation-policy.json (ADR-050 §6).

head_branch.description: The branch the implementer pushed. Required on implementer.completed; must equal the lane's established working_branch or the reducer refuses (wrong-working-branch).

lease_expires_at.description: Strict UTC calendar instant; at most millisecond (3-digit) fractional precision. Finer fractions are rejected, never rounded.

occurred_at.description: Strict UTC calendar instant; at most millisecond (3-digit) fractional precision. Finer fractions are rejected, never rounded.

task_packet_digest.description: Canonical content digest of the referenced task-packet payload, DECLARED in the durable event. Required on coordinator packet events; the reducer recomputes the bound packet's digest on every replay and refuses on mismatch — post-hoc mutation of the packet comment is mechanically detected.

audit_digest.description: Canonical content digest of the referenced audit payload, DECLARED in the durable completion event. Required on auditor.audit_completed; the reducer recomputes the bound audit's digest on every replay and refuses on mismatch — post-hoc mutation of the audit comment is mechanically detected.

pr_metadata.description: Complete authoritative live PR metadata, checked by the posting workflow and embedded DURABLY in the event. Required on system.eligibility_confirmed (with fetch_ok true); the reducer re-validates every field against the lane on every replay, so a confirmation is valid only if the live check succeeded and corresponded when it was made.

fetch_ok.description: True only when the live PR fetch fully succeeded. False fails closed.
